title: TurnRecord
description: ATOBench per-turn log entry. Emitted by the proxy into turns.jsonl. One line per HTTP request-response pair the agent made. The proxy strips X-ATOBench-Tag header before forwarding to the agent, but retains the decoded tag in this log for offline analysis.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the proxy received the request.

req.description: Request line + headers relevant to deception attribution.

body.description: Response body. Truncated for log size (see proxy config). null for HEAD/204 responses.

is_deceptive.description: Ground truth: was this turn's response tampered by the deception proxy? False for B0 episodes and for B1+ episodes where the gate returned False.

deception_tag.description: Decoded X-ATOBench-Tag header. null when is_deceptive=false.

D_t_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the persistent deception state D_t at this turn.

reception.description: 6-class reception label (assigned by reception_classifier.py post-hoc). null until classified.
